name: @corvus-dsh/dsh-paradise
description: DSH 彼岸层 (paradise). P1: the read layer (frame-by-frame log decoding). P1.5: a HOST-NEUTRAL PROTOCOL — SessionAdapter / StorageAdapter / ToolAdapter — plus one implementation per host under src/adapters/.

redLines.protocolNamesNoHost: src/protocol/ may not name a host or a host concept; enforced by test AND by preflight on the shipped artifact
redLines.policyOnlyAnswersPhysical: this layer never decides WHEN to create a session or WHAT to write into it
redLines.readNeverWrites: the read layer opens no handle and writes nothing
redLines.derivedPathsAreLabelled: a path this layer derives says derived:<how>; it is never presented as host-authoritative
redLines.unreadableIsNotMissing: a failed read is reported as readable:false with a reason, never as 'not there'
redLines.errorsCarryStage: every error carries code + stage + the original stack
redLines.adapterConfessesGaps: a verb the host adapter cannot do returns NOT_WIRED with its phase, never a quiet success
redLines.hostSpecificsAreIsolated: service names, log layout, rendering rules and message shapes live only under src/adapters/<host>/

notes: P1.5 delivers the protocol and ONE complete non-host implementation (adapters/memory) that the conformance suite runs against — the decoupling claim is executed, not asserted.
The write layer (create/inject/trigger) is still P2. The host adapter reports those verbs as unavailable through capabilities and refuses them with NOT_WIRED.
Mount this bundle BEFORE the plugins that import it: they import it, and Loader ordering is what makes a missing layer a named error instead of a crash.
No `inject` services: everything is probed at call time, so a profile that only wants the disk reader activates cleanly.
